parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~2319131~~) operation to query information about all clusters in the destination region, including cluster IDs.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> Call the [DescribeRegions](~~2319134~~) operation to query information about the available regions of the destination account, including region IDs.

parameters.name: TDERegion
parameters.description: The region where the transparent data encryption (TDE) key is located.
